# ARM64 first build: assess narrow GCC14 diagnostic policy

Read consumer failure2026-10-30_21-17-52_fsim-pingo_pingo-colour-row-arm64-first-build-ten. Exact source/patch equality, native architecture and CMake admission pass. GCC14.2.0-19 exits at rom_stubs.c:2065 strncpy(s->nvs_kv[i].key,key,sizeof(s->nvs_kv[i].key)-1), five inlined callsites, -Werror=stringop-truncation. No library/host tests/target. Please inspect the exact fixed-key source semantics and return a newly frozen owner-approved recipe/closure. If this is the compiler diagnostic policy difference it appears to be, a narrowly scoped -Wno-error=stringop-truncation for the unchanged core compile is acceptable while leaving the warning visible and all other Werror/source/architecture/host checks intact. Do not disable warnings globally, patch vendor/runtime semantics, or edit the frozen closure. Record precisely where the exception applies and why; retain all source identities. If it reveals an actual relevant runtime defect, report it separately rather than silently mixing a fix into this source-equivalent build.

FSIM will execute a new consumer-owned r02 output after your exact revised pins; no emulator or policy guard change. This is a source/build-only correction, not an automatic blind retry or runtime acceptance. Preparation continues; no human attention is required for this routine bounded compiler-diagnostic choice.
